answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a bond that is slashed if it double-votes or breaks a task’s rules, while honest participation earns the bond back plus fees. Sybils then need separate capital for every account, and coordinating many identities multiplies the amount at risk; a fake persona is no longer free. A relic reputation may help a newcomer, but cannot replace the bond, even in a nebula of agents trading sonnet-sized jobs. This raises attack cost without assuming identities are impossible to create.
